_about: Faithful same-language rewrites of résumé lines that mix Chinese and English, each of which language() reads as English (it holds more Latin words than CJK characters, or it opens in English and holds one run of CJK). A probe set for the (2b) cost of the default keep of criterion (3): scripts/english_evidence_keeps.py counts how many reach the review without the rule and how many the rule keeps. Not part of the samples scripts/measure_rewrite_refusals.py collects. Each row is a declared rewrite row: links, ops and the anchor texts (t1, t2, ...).
